stage0_authority.dog_and_bone_mask_policy: Reference the reviewed SAM2 r2 binary masks byte-for-byte; do not redraw or replace them.

label_contract.dog#1: Full visible dog mask from the Stage-0 SAM2 r2 authority.
label_contract.dog#1.head: Conservative box around the visible craniofacial region, including ears, muzzle, and open jaw; not a pixel-perfect part mask.
label_contract.dog#1.mouth: Box around the visible oral opening and immediate lip/teeth/tongue boundary; this is the effector region, not target RGB.
label_contract.bone#1: Original right-side bone mask from the Stage-0 SAM2 r2 authority.
label_contract.bone#1.support: supported_by(bone#1,ground#1), represented by an 8-pixel mask-bbox expansion as a ground-context proxy.
label_contract.safe-background#1: A fixed lower-right concrete patch outside dog, bone, vehicle edge, and the planned bone-to-mouth corridor.

safe_background_policy.selection_reason: Lower-right concrete remains visually unobstructed and is separated from dog, bone, vehicle edge, and the weak source-to-mouth trajectory.

sparse_annotations.ambiguity: The left lip curls upward; the mouth box deliberately includes the visible lip and tongue boundary.
Right cheek and lip are foreshortened; the box includes the complete visible aperture without asserting a hidden boundary.
Strong upward perspective exposes palate, tongue, and teeth; the annotation is a routing region rather than an anatomical segmentation.
The open jaw dominates the projected head; lip and tooth boundaries are retained inside one conservative effector box.
Tongue, teeth, and dark oral cavity are all visible; no sub-part ordering inside the mouth is claimed.
The left oral corner is shadowed; the box covers only the visible mouth region and makes no hidden-surface claim.
Muzzle and upper lip partly overhang the oral cavity; the region is intentionally box-level.
Right teeth occlude part of the inner lip; the box does not hallucinate the occluded contour.
The right oral corner is partly occluded by teeth and perspective; only the visible effector envelope is annotated.

claim_limits.reason_full_g0_not_authorized: The sparse annotation half has one primary review only; the separately required independent second review remains pending.
